# What might an unfair dismissal claim be worth?

> Free UK unfair dismissal compensation estimate: basic award, compensatory award, the 52-week cap, Polkey and ACAS adjustments, and your claim deadline. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/uk-unfair-dismissal-compensation-calculator/)
